intro.author: Hosea son of Beeri (1:1), a prophet of the northern kingdom of Israel
intro.written: From about 755 BC until near the fall of Samaria in 722 BC
intro.audience: The northern kingdom of Israel (often called Ephraim or Samaria) in its final decades
intro.setting: Hosea began under King Jeroboam II, when Israel was prosperous but spiritually corrupt, and continued through a chaotic period of assassinated kings, payments to Assyria and the approach of Samaria's fall in 722 BC. Worship of Baal, the Canaanite god of rain and fertility, had blended with Israel's worship of the Lord.
intro.purpose: To expose Israel's unfaithfulness to God as spiritual adultery, warn of coming judgment, and announce God's stubborn, healing love.
intro.bigIdea: Israel has been an unfaithful wife, but God's love will not let her go.

outline.title: Hosea's marriage as a living parable
Charges against priests, people and kings
Love that will not give up, and a call to return
